Tempo Map Kind

  • CURIE: gmeow:TempoMapKind
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TempoMapKind
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

The curve shape of a TempoMap or segment — constant, linear ramp, curve, or measured. A value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:TempoMapKind as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
